meta.matrix_convention: all matrices are row-major nested arrays: M[i][j] = R's M[i,j] (1-based in R, 0-based in JSON)
meta.description: log_likelihood(Bx_i = c(mu, gamma), y_i = y) fixtures for d = 3, 4, 5. y is always exactly unit-normalised in R before the call (y_norm_check).
meta.seed_note: set.seed(777) once; per d the RNG order is: eps <- rnorm(d)*0.01, then rand_sphere() draws (rnorm(d) each) in case order
meta.intermediates_note: intermediates are recomputed in the driver with the same formulas as log_likelihood(): V_inv = covariance_inv_matrix(mu, lambda, R) (from ESAG.R), yVy = y'V^-1 y, a = y'mu / sqrt(yVy), Mp recursion, M_p = Mp[d-1], log_Cd = log((2*pi)^(-(d-1)/2)). log_likelihood = log_Cd - (d/2) log(yVy) + 0.5*((y'mu)^2/yVy - mu'mu) + log(M_p)
meta.delicate_note: cases named *_numerically_delicate have a << 0, where M_p = a*pnorm(a)+dnorm(a) (etc.) suffers cancellation; expect only ~1e-6..1e-9 relative agreement there unless the port uses the same pnorm/dnorm algorithms
